look: Opal Harpy, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Opal Sirens family: screeching harpy with opal-feathered wings and taloned feet, ragged cloth wraps. Family anatomy: winged women-shaped sirens and harpies with opal-feathered wings and taloned feet. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are blood-red opal. A golf-ball-sized GKOM core orb, cloudy amber, faint glow, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, small subtle ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
